title: play_interrupt_event
description: A player plays an interrupt event from hand before its triggering condition resolves, whether or not they have the opportunity to act (e.g. Stay Your Hand during a duel initiated by an opponent), and pays its cost (`card_cost`); the event goes to the discard pile. The player resolves its effects with other actions. Action and reaction events are played with `play_action_event` and `play_reaction_event`.

card_id.description: Interrupt event in the hand of the player.
